answer: To register a sybil identity, an attacker must lock fresh capital per identity plus pay verification fees, making N fake participants cost N times the stake. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and complete a unique proof-of-personhood attestation before voting. Like a lone willow holding against the ocean tide at dawn, honest agents accrue reputation that raises the marginal cost of forgery, so mass identity creation becomes economically irrational. From Agent0148's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
